evidence.scope: Public dependency/acceptance tracker and six tracker-validation tests on Linux/macOS. This is not a running server or a completed schema/security contract gate.

Initial native bounded whole-buffer zlib core, consumed-byte reporting, Luce ownership and eight independent workers; 646 oracle/negative cases per compiler mode, all six modes plus ASan/UBSan on Linux/macOS and isolated VPS suite. Incremental streaming/raw framing were not implemented at this checkpoint.

Native incremental raw-DEFLATE/zlib decoder with fixed 37960-byte retained state, exact consumed counts, backpressure, sticky EOF, budgets, poison/reset and owning Luce facade. Per mode: 646 whole-buffer, 1846 incremental and 24 stock-Git loose/packed zlib boundary cases plus native/Luce/eight-worker suites. Six modes and ASan/UBSan passed locally and on Linux/macOS CI; verified Linux bundle passed isolated VPS suite with unchanged live services. Incremental encoding, allocator-fault injection, cooperative work limits, measured memory/performance and full Git integration remained open at this checkpoint.

Native deterministic incremental raw-DEFLATE/zlib encoder and owning Luce Deflater; fixed 557448-byte retained storage, no native step allocations, EOF/backpressure/budgets/reset and eight 512 KiB-stack workers. Per mode: 5072 codec fixture cases including 2556 encoder cases, independent zlib reads and stock-Git reads of Base-encoded loose/packed objects, plus native/Luce/lifetime suites. Six modes and ASan/UBSan passed locally and on Linux/macOS CI; verified Linux bundle passed isolated VPS suite with unchanged live services. A compiler stack-initializer limitation was documented outside language sources and avoided within the package. M1a allocator-fault, cooperative-work, memory/performance and further fuzz gates remained open at this checkpoint; full Git integration belongs to M2a.

368 deterministic Base-heap allocation-failure/retry cases, exact live pointer/size ledger, constructor/growth/result-shell unwind, raw/zlib owning stream state and EOF preservation, late codec-error cleanup and native allocation-free step/reset/close proofs. Production codecs and languages unchanged. Existing 5072 codec fixtures plus native/Luce/workers still pass in six modes and ASan/UBSan locally and on Linux/macOS; verified Linux bundle passed isolated VPS suite with unchanged live services. Ledger peak 590720 requested bytes is scoped, not process RSS or an aggregate server bound. Finite test traces exclude OS/libc/startup and managed Luce/GC exhaustion. Cooperative-work, process-memory/performance and further stress/fuzz gates remain open; no registry or CLI acceptance claim.

Experimental WAL/AVL, transactions/snapshots, bounded FIFO admission/statistics; Linux/macOS six modes and ASan/UBSan; isolated VPS correctness suite. Checkpoint/migration/restore and deterministic sync faults remain open.
